goal.objective: Execute the corrected StegVerse heartbeat sampler once under the canonical resident runtime and persist inspectable oscillator-backed carrier observation proving that heartbeat progression depends only on the independent 10 ms phase oscillator; independently admitted WorkerCoordinator task control verifies the resulting evidence without becoming causal to heartbeat progression.
success_predicates: Carrier runtime state persists nested oscillator.phase_travel_time_ms=10 and oscillator.snapshot_is_observation_only=true.
Carrier observation records observation_is_causal=false and authority_effect=NONE.
Heartbeat ordinal is sampled from elapsed oscillator quanta rather than incremented by invocation.
Live-proof task admission is independent task control; carrier observation or compatibility trigger carriage is not execution authority or a prerequisite for claimability.
No GitHub token or NON-TV/TVC secret/token is required or forwarded.
StegVerse remains primary; third-party runtime is not required.
failure_predicates: Observed carrier state still uses GATE_PASSBAND_DERIVED as the progression rule.
Observed carrier state lacks canonical nested oscillator-only provenance.
WorkerCoordinator, assignment-trigger carriage, or a task state is made causal to heartbeat progression or task authority.
A NON-TV/TVC credential or GitHub token becomes runtime authority.
A third-party runtime becomes required or primary.
authority_ceiling: execute the canonical StegVerse heartbeat sampler
independently verify live proof under existing task-control authority

task.derivation_reason: Source correction is complete; the remaining required outcome is live sovereign execution evidence from the corrected sampler plus independent verification under existing task-control authority.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted StegVerse task-control execution opportunity while HANDOFF_READY
activation.bootstrap_semantics: The first worker cycle materializes registry fragments and independently observes claimable work under task-control authority. The carrier process independently samples/persists the oscillator-produced reference; any assignment-trigger packet it carries is compatibility observation with authority_effect=NONE, not a prerequisite for claimability or execution. The next worker cycle independently validates authority, binds a fresh claim/fence when lawful, and executes the live-proof worker against the persisted oscillator evidence. Neither worker cycle causes the heartbeat and the carrier sample grants no execution authority.

completion.next_authorized_action: Any compliant StegVerse task-control execution using the canonical WorkerCoordinator may now directly acquire this HANDOFF_READY task under a fresh fence >21; no heartbeat-carried assignment trigger is required. Execute the corrected carrier sampler and verify canonical nested oscillator carrier/observation evidence, then return COMPLETED / INDEPENDENT_HEARTBEAT_LIVE_PROOF_VERIFIED.
terminal_when: Carrier state contains frequency_rule=INDEPENDENT_OSCILLATOR_10MS_PHASE_TRAVEL and canonical nested oscillator invariants.
Carrier observation contains phase_travel_time_ms=10, observation_is_causal=false and authority_effect=NONE.
WorkerCoordinator binds the task under a fresh fenced claim using independently admitted task-control authority and the finite cost basis.
No carrier event, compatibility trigger packet, GitHub workflow, or observer is represented as execution authority.
